vintage: NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025 (some lenses 2024 or earlier; each lens states its year); NSO monthly report Oct 2026; NSO 2019 census; VCCI PCI 2022; WorldPop 2025; ESA WorldCover 2021; IBTrACS; CHELSA V2.1 (1981–2010); Hansen Global Forest Change 2001–2025; ETOPO1; OpenStreetMap

lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: WorldPop 2025 estimated residents in the hex (1 km pixels, constrained to built-up areas, adjusted to UN totals) ÷ the hex's 65 km².

lenses.name: Urban share
lenses.unit: share of residents living in urban areas
lenses.description: Urban population ÷ average population, 2025 (NSO, preliminary). Urban follows Vietnam's administrative definition (wards and towns).

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Average population 2025 ÷ 2019 − 1, by former province (NSO PX-Web V02.03-07 for 2019, Statistical Yearbook 2025 for 2025, preliminary).

lenses.name: GRDP per person
lenses.description: Gross regional domestic product per person, 2025, current prices (NSO estimate), converted at the World Bank 2024 rate (the 2025 rate is not yet published).
lenses.note: Counted where output is made: oil, mining and industrial provinces score high even where incomes are modest.

lenses.name: Productivity
lenses.description: Labour productivity: GRDP ÷ employed workers, 2025 (NSO, preliminary), converted at the World Bank 2024 rate.

lenses.name: Business climate
lenses.description: Provincial Competitiveness Index 2022 (VCCI/USAID), the last year scored for all 63 provinces: a survey of private firms on transparency, costs, land access and governance.
lenses.note: PCI 2025 covers the 34 new provinces but publishes only sub-indices and rank groups, no composite score.

lenses.name: Foreign investment
lenses.description: Newly registered plus added foreign direct investment capital in 2025 ÷ average population 2025, by the 34 provinces (NSO). Provinces with no registration in 2025 are 0.
lenses.note: Registered capital, not money disbursed; one large project can dominate a province's year.

lenses.name: Enterprises
lenses.description: Active enterprises per 1,000 residents at 31 December 2025, by the 34 provinces (NSO).

lenses.name: Growth, 9 months 2026 (est.)
lenses.unit: GRDP growth vs the first 9 months of 2025
lenses.description: Estimated GRDP growth of January–September 2026 over the same period of 2025, at constant 2020 prices, by the 34 provinces (NSO socio-economic report for September 2026, published October 2026).
lenses.note: An estimate; NSO revises it with the full-year figures.

lenses.name: Factory jobs 2026 (est.)
lenses.unit: industrial-enterprise jobs vs a year earlier
lenses.description: Change in the number of workers in industrial enterprises at 1 October 2026 compared with 1 October 2025, by the 34 provinces (NSO socio-economic report for October 2026, estimate).

lenses.name: Income
lenses.description: Average monthly income per person (Vietnam Household Living Standards Survey, 2025) × 12, converted at the World Bank 2024 rate.
lenses.note: Income per person, not per household.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Share of households poor by Vietnam's multidimensional poverty standard for 2022–2025 (income plus access to jobs, health, education, housing, water and sanitation, information), 2025 (NSO, preliminary).

lenses.name: Inequality
lenses.description: Gini coefficient of per-person income, 2025 (NSO, VHLSS, preliminary). 0 = everyone earns the same.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.unit: unemployed share of the working-age labour force
lenses.description: Unemployment rate of the labour force in working age, 2025 (NSO Labour Force Survey, preliminary).
lenses.note: Low everywhere: informal work absorbs most people who lose a job.

lenses.name: Internet users
lenses.description: Share of people who used the internet, 2025 (NSO, preliminary).

lenses.name: Clean water
lenses.unit: population using a hygienic water source
lenses.description: Share of the population whose main drinking water comes from a hygienic source, 2025 (NSO, preliminary).
lenses.note: Above 95% almost everywhere; the colours separate the few provinces that lag.

lenses.name: Permanent housing
lenses.unit: households living in a permanent house
lenses.description: Share of households whose house is permanent (kiên cố), 2024 (NSO; the 2025 yearbook's latest housing survey). The rest live in semi-permanent, less-permanent or simple houses.
lenses.note: Mekong Delta provinces score low: houses on stilts and of light materials are common there.

lenses.name: Human development
lenses.description: Human Development Index by the 34 provinces, 2025 (NSO, preliminary): health, education and income combined, 0–1.
lenses.note: NSO publishes HDI only for the 34 provinces from 2025; the former provinces' tables keep their 2024 values.

lenses.name: Doctors
lenses.description: Doctors working in State-sector health facilities in 2025 per 10,000 residents (average population 2025), by the 34 provinces (NSO).
lenses.note: Private-sector doctors are not counted.

lenses.name: Road deaths
lenses.description: People killed in road traffic accidents in 2025 per 100,000 residents, by the 34 provinces (NSO).

lenses.name: Trained workers
lenses.unit: workers 15+ with vocational or higher training
lenses.description: Share of the labour force aged 15+ holding a vocational certificate, college or university degree, 2025 (NSO Labour Force Survey, preliminary).

lenses.name: Literacy
lenses.unit: people 15+ who can read and write
lenses.description: Literacy rate of people aged 15 and over, 2024 (NSO; the latest published by province).

lenses.name: IT skills
lenses.description: Share of people with at least one information-technology skill (copying files, sending e-mail, using a spreadsheet…), 2025 (NSO, preliminary).

lenses.name: Pupils per teacher
lenses.description: General-education pupils (primary to upper secondary) per teacher at 30 September 2025, by the 34 provinces (NSO).

lenses.name: Typhoons
lenses.description: Distinct tropical cyclones of at least tropical-storm strength (34 kt, JMA 10-minute winds; JTWC's only for a storm JMA did not track) whose IBTrACS best track passed within 100 km of the hex centre, 1980 to today.
lenses.note: Counts storm passages, not damage: floods and landslides from storms that pass further away are not counted.

lenses.name: Forest cover (official)
lenses.description: Official forest cover rate at 31 December 2025 (natural and planted forest ÷ area), by the 34 provinces (NSO, from the forestry sector's monitoring). The Forest lens next to it measures tree cover from satellite imagery.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as forest.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as farmland.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as built-up.

lenses.name: Wetland & mangrove
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that ESA WorldCover 2021 classes as wetland & mangrove.

lenses.name: Rainfall
lenses.description: Average annual precipitation (CHELSA BIO12). CHELSA V2.1, averages of 1981–2010 downscaled from the ERA5 reanalysis with terrain (30 arc-second pixels, ~0.9 km, averaged per hex). Karger et al. 2017, Scientific Data 4: 170122; CC0 1.0.
lenses.note: Climate normals of 1981–2010, not recent years.

lenses.name: Temperature
lenses.description: Mean annual air temperature (CHELSA BIO1). CHELSA V2.1, averages of 1981–2010 downscaled from the ERA5 reanalysis with terrain (30 arc-second pixels, ~0.9 km, averaged per hex). Karger et al. 2017, Scientific Data 4: 170122; CC0 1.0.
lenses.note: Climate normals of 1981–2010; Vietnam has warmed since.

lenses.name: Hottest-month highs
lenses.description: Average daily maximum temperature of the warmest month (CHELSA BIO5). CHELSA V2.1, averages of 1981–2010 downscaled from the ERA5 reanalysis with terrain (30 arc-second pixels, ~0.9 km, averaged per hex). Karger et al. 2017, Scientific Data 4: 170122; CC0 1.0.

lenses.name: Coldest-month lows
lenses.description: Average daily minimum temperature of the coldest month (CHELSA BIO6). CHELSA V2.1, averages of 1981–2010 downscaled from the ERA5 reanalysis with terrain (30 arc-second pixels, ~0.9 km, averaged per hex). Karger et al. 2017, Scientific Data 4: 170122; CC0 1.0.

lenses.name: Forest loss since 2001
lenses.description: Share of the hex's year-2000 forest (tree canopy ≥ 30%) with stand-replacing loss in 2001–2025 (Hansen Global Forest Change v1.13, Landsat). Hexes with under 2 km² of forest in 2000 are blank.
lenses.note: Gross loss, including plantation harvests that are replanted; regrowth is not counted.

lenses.name: Low-lying land (≤ 2 m)
lenses.unit: share of land at or below 2 m
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples (ETOPO1, 1 arc-minute, ~1.8 km) at or below 2 m above sea level.
lenses.note: A coarse 1-arc-minute elevation indicator, not a flood model: no dykes, tides or drainage.

lenses.name: Schools mapped
lenses.description: Schools (amenity=school) mapped in OpenStreetMap in the hex (about 65 km²).
lenses.note: Shows how well schools are mapped, not how many there are: OpenStreetMap covers cities far better than the countryside, and Vietnam publishes no school locations as open data.

lenses.name: Largest ethnic group
lenses.description: The ethnic group with the most residents in each former province on census day, 1 April 2019. Kinh are the largest group in 55 of the 63 former provinces.
lenses.note: NSO, Completed results of the 2019 Population and Housing Census, Table 2. Each hex shows its former province; minorities living in parts of a province are not visible.

lenses.name: Ethnic minorities
lenses.description: Share of residents belonging to one of the 53 ethnic minorities (all groups except Kinh), census of 1 April 2019, by former province.
lenses.note: NSO, Completed results of the 2019 Population and Housing Census, Table 2. Nationally 14.7%.

lenses.name: Rice
lenses.description: Rice production in 2025 (preliminary) per km² of the former province's area, tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 198).
lenses.note: A province total spread over the whole province: the fields themselves are not mapped.

lenses.name: Maize
lenses.description: Maize production in 2025 (preliminary) per km² of the former province's area, tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 210).
lenses.note: A province total spread over the whole province: the fields themselves are not mapped.

lenses.name: Cassava
lenses.description: Cassava production in 2025 (preliminary) per km² of the former province's area, tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 214).
lenses.note: NSO lists only the 40 main producing former provinces for this crop; the others show no data (small or no production, not published).

lenses.name: Sugarcane
lenses.description: Sugarcane production in 2025 (preliminary) per km² of the former province's area, tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 216).
lenses.note: A province total spread over the whole province: the fields themselves are not mapped.

lenses.name: Tea
lenses.description: Tea production in 2025 (preliminary) per km² of the former province's area, tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 222).
lenses.note: NSO lists only the 12 main producing former provinces for this crop; the others show no data (small or no production, not published).

lenses.name: Orange
lenses.description: Orange production in 2025 (preliminary) per km² of the former province's area, tonnes (NSO Statistical Yearbook 2025, table 223).
lenses.note: NSO lists only the 20 main producing former provinces for this crop; the others show no data (small or no production, not published).
